info.title: Consumer API for Freight Tendering
info.description:
Provides functionality for managing freight requests for quotation and freight quotations as part of the freight tendering process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems.
This specification describes the API from the viewpoint of SAP Business Network for Logistics as the consumer of API.
SAP Business Network for Logistics calls the defined endpoints within other systems.

x-sap-shortText: Enables carriers to manage freight requests for quotation and freight quotations as part of the freight tendering process.

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

post.summary: Creates a freight request for quotation in another system.
post.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party creates a freight request for quotation.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Freight request for quotation to be created.

201.description: Freight request for quotation created successfully.

application/json.message: Relationship betweeen the ordering party (ID: 10000042) and the carrier (ID: 10000043) has not yet been established.

post.summary: Cancels a freight request for quotation in another system.
post.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party cancels a freight request for quotation.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: orderingPartyLbnId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

parameters.name: originatorId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party's originating system.

parameters.name: freightRequestForQuotationId
parameters.description: Identifier of the freight request for quotation.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Freight request for quotation to be canceled.

200.description: Freight request for quotation canceled successfully.

application/json.message: Freight request for quotation [ID: 6100034059, Originator ID: XYZ_123, Ordering Party LBN ID: 10000042] could not be found
Relationship of Ordering Party (shipper) LBN Id: 10000042 and Carrier Party LBN Id: 10000043 has not yet been established

post.summary: Awards or rejects a freight quotation in another system.
post.description:
This interface is called by SAP Business Network for Logistics when an ordering party awards or rejects a freight quotation.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: orderingPartyLbnId
parameters.description: Identifier of the ordering party within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

parameters.name: originatorId
parameters.description: Identifier of the originating system of the ordering party.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Freight quotation to be awarded or rejected.

200.description: Freight quotation awarded or rejected successfully.

application/json.message: Freight request for quotation [ID: 6100034059, Originator ID: XYZ_123, Ordering Party LBN ID: 10000042] could not be found
Relationship of Ordering Party (shipper) LBN Id: 10000042 and Carrier Party LBN Id: 10000043 has not yet been established
